create_NNAgent: create an NNAgent instance with a model and number of actions for discrete action selection
run_NNAgent_call: run one step of the NNAgent to sample an action given an observation and state
update_NNAgent_model: update the NNAgent model weights by loading a new state dictionary
create_MLPAgentModel: create an MLPAgentModel with linear layers for action scoring and value estimation
create_GRUAgentModel: create a GRUAgentModel with a GRU cell for recurrent action scoring and value estimation
